import json,urllib.request,collections,statistics as st,datetime
d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen('http://localhost:8091/api/runs',timeout=60))
TFM={'1m':1,'3m':3,'5m':5,'15m':15,'30m':30,'1h':60,'2h':120,'4h':240,'1d':1440}
T=[]
for r in d['runs']:
    if r.get('track')!='bot': continue
    for x in r['trades']:
        if x['open']: continue
        y=dict(x); y['tf']=r['cfg']['tf']; y['sym']=r['sym']; y['rid']=r['id']
        y['risk_p']=abs(x['p_in']-x['stop0'])/x['p_in']*100
        y['rew_p']=abs(x['tp']-x['p_in'])/x['p_in']*100 if x.get('tp') else None
        T.append(y)
n=len(T); print('n closed bot-run trades',n)
m=lambda a:round(sum(a)/len(a),3) if a else None
print('mean gross',m([t['gross'] for t in T]),'mean net',m([t['net'] for t in T]),'win%',round(100*sum(1 for t in T if t['net']>0)/n,1))
print('mean risk%',m([t['risk_p'] for t in T]),'median',round(st.median([t['risk_p'] for t in T]),3))
rw=[t['rew_p'] for t in T if t['rew_p']]; print('mean reward% (tp dist)',m(rw),'median',round(st.median(rw),3))
def grp(f,name,minn=1):
    g=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for t in T: g[f(t)].append(t)
    print('==',name)
    for k,v in sorted(g.items(),key=lambda kv:str(kv[0])):
        if len(v)<minn: continue
        print(' ',k,'n',len(v),'win%',round(100*sum(1 for t in v if t['net']>0)/len(v)),'gross',m([t['gross'] for t in v]),'net',m([t['net'] for t in v]))
grp(lambda t:t['sig'],'sig k=breakout b=bounce')
grp(lambda t:t['tf'],'tf')
grp(lambda t:t['side'],'side')
grp(lambda t:(t['sig'],t['side']),'sig+side')
grp(lambda t:('<0.3' if t['risk_p']<0.3 else '0.3-0.6' if t['risk_p']<0.6 else '0.6-1' if t['risk_p']<1 else '>1'),'risk bucket')
def rr(t):
    if not t['rew_p']: return 'no tp'
    q=t['rew_p']/t['risk_p']; return 'rr<0.7' if q<0.7 else 'rr0.7-1.2' if q<1.2 else 'rr>1.2'
grp(rr,'reward/risk bucket')
grp(lambda t:t['reason'],'reason')
# random-walk benchmark: P(target first)=risk/(risk+reward)
S=[t for t in T if t['reason'] in ('\u0441\u0442\u043e\u043f','\u0446\u0435\u043b\u044c') and t['rew_p']]
exp=sum(t['risk_p']/(t['risk_p']+t['rew_p']) for t in S); act=sum(1 for t in S if t['reason']=='\u0446\u0435\u043b\u044c')
print('stop/target only: n',len(S),'target hits actual',act,'expected by random walk',round(exp,1))
# stops: how fast and how far did they go before
ST=[t for t in T if t['reason']=='\u0441\u0442\u043e\u043f']
bars=[(t['t_out']-t['t_in'])/60000/TFM.get(t['tf'],5) for t in ST]
print('stops n',len(ST),'median bars to stop',round(st.median(bars),1),'share<=2 bars',round(100*sum(1 for b in bars if b<=2)/len(bars)),'%')
print('stops mfe: mean',m([t['mfe'] for t in ST]),'share mfe>=0.5*risk',round(100*sum(1 for t in ST if t['mfe']>=0.5*t['risk_p'])/len(ST)),'%','share mfe>=risk',round(100*sum(1 for t in ST if t['mfe']>=t['risk_p'])/len(ST)),'%','share mfe>=0.2',round(100*sum(1 for t in ST if t['mfe']>=0.2)/len(ST)),'%')
print('stops: share where stop dist < 3x fee(0.1)',round(100*sum(1 for t in ST if t['risk_p']<0.3)/len(ST)),'%')
# by day and by hour
def day(t): return datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(t['t_in']/1000,datetime.timezone.utc).strftime('%m-%d')
grp(day,'day utc')
grp(lambda t:datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(t['t_in']/1000,datetime.timezone.utc).hour//6*6,'hour utc bucket')
g=collections.defaultdict(list)
for t in T: g[t['sym']].append(t['net'])
print('== sym net sum (n)')
for k,v in sorted(g.items(),key=lambda kv:sum(kv[1]))[:8]: print(' ',k,len(v),round(sum(v),1))
for k,v in sorted(g.items(),key=lambda kv:-sum(kv[1]))[:4]: print(' +',k,len(v),round(sum(v),1))
